HELIX field guide / 03

Evolution you can see.

Every body in this terrarium is built from a 10-gene genome. The basin decides which bodies survive.

01

Read the pressures

Climate selects body size and heat exchange. Sparse forage favors reach. Predators favor speed and armor. Change the basin and the optimum changes.

02

Choose a survivor

Click any creature or step through the population. The dossier shows the four fitness components currently under selection.

03

Evolve the lineage

Advance a generation. The six strongest genomes recombine, mutate, and hatch. Mutagen lets you steer one allele by hand.

04

Real rules, strange bodies

Large bodies hold heat (Bergmann's rule), long extremities shed it (Allen's rule), and armor trades feeding efficiency for survival.
